# BTE-Tech

BTE-Tech automates application pre-screening, financial audits, and credential verification for universities and enterprise employers.

## About
BTE-Tech connects university admissions and global employer hiring through automated verification, compliance triage, and international talent pipelines.

## University Solutions
We provide intelligent compliance workflows, financial 28-day rule audits, transcript verification, and sponsor-license protection for higher education institutions.

## Company Solutions
We deliver pre-vetted international talent pipelines through academic qualification checks, background screening assistance, financial compliance verification, and hiring readiness workflows.
